shape_and_identity.ecdf: Input length plus zero/one/two constant-Y extension endpoints. Invalid/null/mismatched source retains original array values; public payload snapshots. Private Windows no-extension/invalid aliases preserved.
shape_and_identity.ladder: Stable source/input ordinal and tie order, endpoint/side/label vectors and text; explicit acquired plot height/separation; original spreading/clamping reused. HashSet group legend state and physical acquisition stay Windows.
shape_and_identity.bullet: Explicit-size scale/band/bar/target rectangles, labels, tick geometry and palette-index/format intent; original clip/admission/defaults; RGB/font/shape ownership remains Windows.
shape_and_identity.sankey: Existing flow solver unchanged. Explicit-size ordered node/ribbon cubic anchors, stage/legend/label geometry; existing basis/culture formatting; native text measurement, RGB/freeform/resize/cleanup remain Windows.
shape_and_identity.references: Exactly two ordered endpoints; affine uses intercept+slope*x without refitting; identity/horizontal/vertical copy-safe arrays.
shape_and_identity.spc: Post-extents empty[0,1], constant10%/other7% padding and existing natural-zero/proportion clamp; accepted ten-channel/mask/stage projection unchanged. Detailed series and annotations reserved36.
shape_and_identity.love: Existing accepted projection retains order/absolute-SMD/masks/threshold/maxX; new finite-series predicate and two-point threshold only. No guard correction.
shape_and_identity.timing: Integer milliseconds to centiseconds using original max(1, CInt(Math.Round(max(0,ms)/10))). Encoding/file/GDI+ stays Windows.
shape_and_identity.dumbbell: Accepted paired categories/auxiliary SourceIndex vectors; connectors preserve orientation and empty admission, axis125/tick rules and numeric labels; native date interpretation/pixel offset/styles unchanged.
shape_and_identity.cdf: Accepted empirical/fitted/percentile vectors and defaults; portable axes/formats/legend branch intent and three-point L references. Invalid/no-extension alias behavior preserved in the Windows private wrapper.
